name: Outreach
description: Turn pasted research into lead cards on a kanban board, operated by the agent in the terminal. Bring your own Claude / Codex / Gemini. It ingests prospect notes, replies, and call transcripts — enriching leads additively (never clobbering), summarizing transcripts, drafting messages it never auto-sends, and proposing card moves through dryRun/confirm gates. Every write goes through an append-only, fully reversible event log, so nothing is ever lost.
creator: altramanera
